auth_methods.quote: An LWA access token expires one hour after it is issued.
auth_methods.note: Login with Amazon OAuth 2.0 (refresh token -> LWA access token); private apps self-authorize. Restricted operations use Restricted Data Tokens derived from LWA.

credential_access.quote: You must register as a Selling Partner API (SP-API) developer before you can register your Selling Partner API application.
credential_access.note: Two readings: partner_gated (developer profile application reviewed by Amazon, with extra architecture review for restricted roles) vs paid_plan_required (private seller apps need a professional selling account, a paid plan). Best guess: partner_gated. Evidence: https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/sp-api-registration-overview

production_gate.quote: public developers must list their app in the Amazon Selling Partner Appstore
production_gate.note: Public (multi-seller) apps must be listed on the Selling Partner Appstore; restricted roles also need architecture/security review.

api_type.quote: The Selling Partner API (SP-API) is a REST-based API
api_type.note: Also Data Kiosk (GraphQL queries via REST endpoints) but primary type REST.

mcp_official.quote: developer tools (including MCP servers and a local sandbox)
mcp_official.note: Amazon-run github.com/amzn repo ships SP-API Dev Assistant, Workflow, and Data Kiosk MCP servers (local, npm).

main_blocker_type.quote: Amazon evaluates developer applications through a comprehensive review process.
main_blocker_type.note: Developer profile review, Appstore listing, and PII architecture review gate access.
